# Percept

Percept (`percept-vision 1.0.0`) is an open-source cognition layer for goal-driven, proactive
audio-visual agents. It turns plain-language watch goals into rising-edge events: `fire` when a
condition becomes true, `ask` when the read is uncertain, and silence otherwise. Website and docs:
https://percept.percia.ai

## Start Here

- `README.md`: product overview, install commands, architecture, package map, benchmark status.
- `AGENTS.md`: verified integration guide for Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, and other coding agents.
- `docs/README.md`: documentation index (Diátaxis: tutorials / how-to / reference / explanation).
- `docs/tutorials/quickstart.md`: 60-second offline first run with the fake backend.
- `docs/explanation/concepts.md`: cognition/perception split, gate, rising-edge firing, entity memory.
- `docs/reference/backends.md`: fake, Gemini, Claude, OpenRouter, Deepgram, and backend selection.

## Package Choices

- Python core: `pip install percept-vision`, then `import percept`.
- Runtime capture worker: `pip install "percept-vision[runtime]"`.
- Benchmark tooling: `pip install "percept-vision[bench]"`, then `percept-bench` (from a repo checkout).
- Python edge/harness: `pip install "percept-vision[edge]"`, imported as `percept.edge`.
- Browser/device edge: `npm install percept-edge`.

The repo bundles `percept.contracts` and `percept.harness` inside `percept-vision`,
but OSS users should start from `percept-vision` plus the optional `percept-edge` npm package.

## Verified Python API

```python
from percept import Percept, Goal

agent = Percept.create(mode="offline", discover_plugins=False)   # keyless scripted backends
agent.add_goal(Goal(id="kettle", condition="the kettle has finished boiling", say="The kettle is done."))
events = await agent.perceive_judged("stopped", source="camera", t=1.0)
```

`events` is a list of `FireEvent`s. `FireEvent.action` is `fire` or `ask`. Treat `ask` as a refusal
to guess, not as a fire. The batteries-included runtime is `async for incident in percept.run(source=...,
goals=[...], vision="gemini")`.

## Versioning

- Package: `percept-vision 1.0.0`.
- Wire contract: `CONTRACT_VERSION = "1.10.0"` (additive-only; independent of the package version).
- `watch()` entrypoint: `WATCH_VERSION = "1.1.0"`. Adapter conformance: `CONFORMANCE_VERSION = "1.1.0"`.

## Quality Gates

```bash
make test
make test-js
make parity
make audit-benchmark
make scorecard
```

`make audit-benchmark` validates the draft golden manifest and baseline registry. Release benchmark
claims require `percept-bench audit --release`, a full-mode scorecard, no modeled cells, and a
content-hashed release manifest. No Percept accuracy numbers are published yet.
